tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Searches the public programmes of the GoodbyeMatrix index: more than 170 residency programmes in more than 80 countries (golden visa or residence by investment, digital nomad visa, independent means visa, active investor visa, skilled worker visa) and 20 citizenship by investment (second passport) programmes. Filters: country, region, programme type, maximum budget in USD, path to citizenship and dual citizenship. Returns a page of matching programmes (total, offset, limit, nextOffset) with id, name, country, type, minimum amount, physical presence, path to citizenship, dual citizenship and the programme page in German and English. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

country.description: Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example "PT") or name in English or German.

region.description: Region: europe, americas (including the Caribbean), asia, africa, middle_east or oceania.

type.description: Programme type: citizenship_by_investment, residence_by_investment (golden visa), digital_nomad, independent_means (retirees, passive income), active_investor (investor and entrepreneur visas) or skilled_work (skilled worker and talent visas).

max_budget_usd.description: Maximum minimum investment in USD; programmes without a known amount are not matched.

citizenship_path.description: true: programmes with a path to citizenship; false: programmes without one.

dual_citizenship_allowed.description: true: dual citizenship permitted; false: dual citizenship prohibited. Conditional cases match neither.

limit.description: Number of programmes per page (1 to 10, default 10).

offset.description: Start position for the next page (nextOffset of the previous answer).

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Returns one programme of the index in detail. Residency programmes: minimum amount and investment options, physical presence, time to permanent residency and to citizenship, dual citizenship, settlement area, tax system of the country, steps and excerpts of the GoodbyeMatrix programme texts (overview, qualification, costs, benefits, citizenship timeline, legal basis). Citizenship by investment programmes: routes with starting amounts, visa-free destinations, status (cost calculator, on request, coming soon or closed) and official links. Includes the programme page in German and English, the date of the source and consultationNote. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

id.description: Programme id from search_programs or get_country_overview, or a programme name (word order and country codes are tolerated).

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Sets 2 to 5 programmes of the index side by side: type, country, minimum amount, physical presence, time to permanent residency and to citizenship, path to citizenship, dual citizenship, tax system of the country, visa-free destinations and the programme page in German and English, plus the date of the source and consultationNote. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

items.description: Programme id from search_programs or get_country_overview, or a programme name (word order and country codes are tolerated).

ids.description: 2 to 5 programme ids (as returned by search_programs).

tools.name: get_country_overview
tools.description: Summarises a country for moving abroad: tax system (residence-based, territorial, no income tax, remittance basis or citizenship-based), the residency and citizenship by investment programmes of the index in that country with their programme pages, and the GoodbyeMatrix climate map, plus the date of the source and consultationNote. Covers about 200 countries. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

country.description: Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example "PA") or name in English or German.

tools.name: explain_term
tools.description: Explains a term on relocation, residency, citizenship, tax and asset protection from the GoodbyeMatrix glossary (more than 120 terms, for example golden visa, 183-day rule, tax residency certificate, flag theory) with the glossary page in German and English. The definition is returned in the requested language (English or German); a term without an English entry yet comes with the German definition and a note. Related terms are listed when the search term matches several entries. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

term.description: Term in English or German, for example "183-day rule" or "Wegzugsbesteuerung".

tools.name: get_cbi_quote
tools.description: Answers how much citizenship by investment or a second passport costs for a person or family, or compares programmes by total cost. Calculates the indicative cost for a family: government contribution, investment, fees, professional fees, payment phases and total in USD, plus which family members are eligible, processing time, page links and quoteRequestUrl. With one programme it returns that programme; without program it compares all 9 programmes (St Kitts and Nevis, Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Saint Lucia, Vanuatu, Sao Tome and Principe, Nauru, Argentina). Figures are rounded indicative figures (total to the nearest 1,000 USD), binding only after a pre-check; the user receives the exact amounts by requesting the cost breakdown through quoteRequestUrl. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

program.description: Programme key: sao_tome (Sao Tome and Principe), vanuatu, dominica, st_lucia (Saint Lucia), st_kitts (St. Kitts and Nevis), grenada, antigua (Antigua and Barbuda), nauru, argentina. Without a programme, the figures cover all programmes at once.

family.description: Everyone who applies together. The first person is the main applicant (role "main"); only the first person has the role "main". Defaults: a partner counts as married and not same-sex unless stated; a child under 18 counts as dependent.

role.description: Relationship to the main applicant: main, partner, child, parent, parent_in_law, grandparent, grandparent_in_law, sibling.

married.description: Married to the main applicant (partner) or married themselves (other roles).

dependent.description: Dependent on the main applicant (for example a child in education or a parent living in the household).

financially_dependent.description: Financially dependent on the main applicant (relevant for adult children and parents).

nationalities.description: Optional: every citizenship of this person as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (for example ["DE"] or ["RU", "GE"] for dual citizens), as mentioned by the user.

birthplace.description: Optional: country of birth as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, as mentioned by the user.

tools.name: list_cbi_programs
tools.description: For questions about which citizenship by investment (second passport) programmes exist or what they start from: lists the 9 programmes GoodbyeMatrix prices (St Kitts and Nevis, Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Saint Lucia, Vanuatu, Sao Tome and Principe, Nauru, Argentina) with region, route (contribution, investment or both), starting amount in USD for a single applicant, professional fee label, processing time, number of visa-free destinations where known, calculator and programme page links, and short notes. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

tools.name: request_cost_breakdown_link
tools.description: Returns only the personal link (quoteRequestUrl) for one programme and family: the calculator page on goodbyematrix.com with the family already filled in, where the user requests the detailed cost breakdown with the exact amounts by e-mail from the GoodbyeMatrix team. The link carries the family only, never contact details; the user enters their contact details on that page, checks them and sends the request personally; the privacy consent is never preselected. Read-only: it returns a URL only; nothing is sent, booked or stored.

tools.name: request_consultation_link
tools.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to speak with GoodbyeMatrix. Returns the URL of the GoodbyeMatrix consultation page (German or English) and the topics a call covers. The link carries no personal data. Read-only: it returns a URL only; nothing is sent, booked or stored.
